evidence_quotes: ÁREA DE MANANCIAL - EDIFICAÇÃO IRREGULAR -FALTA DE AUTORIZAÇÃO DO PODER PÚBLICO
O objetivo do recurso é evitar a demolição de casa construída em área de proteção de mananciais.
rationale: This TJSP appeal concerns the demolition of an unauthorized house constructed without public authorization in a watershed protection zone (área de proteção de mananciais). Under the calibrated protocol, Brazilian mananciais watershed protection cases are classified as WATER, while strict_service_access_label is marked UNCERTAIN because the dispute solely involves land-use/demolition enforcement in a manancial zone without direct water/sanitation utility service access or direct water abstraction/pollution adjudication. The primary governance category is environmental_protection, and involves_connection_or_informal_settlement is false because no water or sanitation service connection/access is at issue.
